source_scope: Patch for the deployed Area 52 account-wide Mystic Enchant implementation; not an automatic replacement for upstream character-specific handlers.

verification.gameplay: Pending player acceptance; no restart or client installation performed.

client_patch.ui_operation: Append Client-Scrolls.lua to the effective existing member; preserve other Area 52 customizations.
dbc_changes: Item: use scroll item display mappings in scroll-items.json.
ItemDisplayInfo: reuse matching icon rows or add icon-only rows; icon strings are basenames.
ItemAddon: quality from scroll-items.json, flag 0x400000, name/description; item 375250 name Rune of Descension.
client_patch.animations: Native shockwave/glow and rarity sounds are preserved. New bag item plus 0x604 result invokes reveal; 0x609 then 0x5FA invokes collection feedback.

activation: Apply runtime.patch only to the matching deployed source, rebuild, apply its pending world SQL only on Area 52, mount staged Item/ItemDisplayInfo/ItemAddon DBCs, install the combined client archive while closed, and restart Area 52. Keep Bear Cave PTR shut down. This source publication does not publish launcher assets.
